data.daily: October 2026 daily archives; unpublished days from the public market-data API (marked unverified)
data.reference: Coinbase BTC-USD and USDT-USD 1m candles, if reachable

events.rule: notebook-2 price_only_catalog, 4% below the H-minute high, 5-close confirmation

matching: paper rules: caught if an alert falls 30-240 min before the breach; pre-onset if before the 1% onset

stage_decomposition.note: replays (b) and (c) are descriptive comparisons, not rules; all start on 2026-01-01
stages: signal: a score at or above the frozen threshold from 240 min before the peak to the breach
window: a candidate minute 30-240 min before the breach (pre-onset part / in-progress part)
cooldown: the cooldown-only replay emits an alert in the window
budget: the actual budgeted replay emits an alert in the window

status: descriptive; observed before the pre-registration; not part of any confirmatory test; no model, threshold or rule is changed
title: Case study: Binance security incident and Bitcoin decline, 2026-10-29/30 (descriptive)

venue_windows.baseline: 7 days before the first event peak (any H)
venue_windows.flags: minutes above 25 bp (level); minutes more than 10 and 25 bp from the baseline median
venue_windows.milestones: first peak, H=240 peak, H=240 1% onset, H=240 breach, breach + 240 min, data end
venue_windows.spread_usdt_adj_bp: 1e4 * (Binance BTCUSDT * Coinbase USDT-USD / Coinbase BTC-USD - 1); USDT-USD carried forward up to 30 min
